senses.gloss: someone who speaks up for you
gloss_distractors: a new member of a team
someone who pays for a project
senses.caution: Naming someone as your advocate gives them a job they may not have agreed to, and can expose them in front of peers. Lawyers hear it as meaning legal counsel.
senses.definition: A person who argues for you when you are not there.

senses.caution: It ties you to the outcome, so keep it for things you would still defend if they failed. If all you did was agree in a meeting, do not claim it.
senses.definition: To argue openly for a position or a person, putting your reputation at risk.
